text:
The bug is in `toolz/itertoolz.py`, function `sliding_window`. It creates `n` teed iterators and advances the iterator at position `i` by `i` items before zipping them. The first iterator is therefore advanced by one item, so the first window starts at the second element; an input of exactly `n` elements then yields nothing.

I intend to change the offset to advance each iterator by `i - 1` items, preserving the first element in the first iterator while retaining the required successive offsets for the remaining iterators.
